rulings.model: IRS line 10 asks whether the annuity starting date was before 1987 and says Yes means STOP and do not complete the rest of the worksheet; the restatement unconditionally adds lines 6 and 8.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040gi p. 29, Simplified Method Worksheet, line 10: "Was your annuity starting date before 1987? Yes. Do not complete the rest of this worksheet. STOP No. Add lines 6 and 8." The Yes branch is unreachable: annuities with after-tax cost starting before November 19, 1996 (so before 1987) are refused by retirement.special, and retirement.annuity requires a start after November 18, 1996, so the question is answered No on every completed return and lines 10 and 11 are figured, as the line 10 cite records. The skipped-line rule is therefore not engaged. Same as the archived rulings, rechecked.

rulings.model: IRS line 10 says 'Was your annuity starting date before 1987? Yes. STOP Do not complete the rest of this worksheet'; the restatement adds line 6 and line 8 even for a pre-1987 annuity.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040gi (2025) p.29 worksheet lines5/10 give skip/STOP rules for annuities beginning before1987. retirement.special excludes every after-tax-cost annuity starting before November19,1996, and retirement.taxable/amount_a enforce that screen; the positive annuity interface also requires a later start. Hence no supported completed Simplified Method case reaches the pre1987 regime. Retain the later-start computation; this does not claim the standalone worksheet values match an excluded old annuity or that the IRS skip is absent.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040gi (2025) p.29 worksheet preamble includes any entitled death-benefit exclusion in line2. The retirement.special question expressly screens a death-benefit exclusion; retirement.taxable and retirement.amount_a refuse it, as does retirement.rolled. A supported completed distribution therefore has no such addition and uses after-tax cost. The broader source case is excluded, not model noise; no standalone correctness claim is made on an excluded distribution.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040gi (2025) p.29 Table1 includes an older-annuity column. retirement.special expressly screens an after-tax-cost annuity starting before November19,1996, and retirement.annuity asks whether the start is after November18,1996; retirement.taxable/amount_a refuse the excluded case. Supported Simplified Method distributions therefore use the later column. The missing older column is a documented scope reduction, not an error in that IRS column.

rulings.model: The true branch matches, but for non-joint annuities the Table 1 helper uses only the after-November 18, 1996 numbers; IRS Table 1 separately provides a before-November 19, 1996 column (for example, 300 rather than 360 for age 55 or under).
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040gi p. 29, Simplified Method Worksheet, Table 1 for Line 3: "AND your annuity starting date was-- before November 19, 1996, enter on line 3... after November 18, 1996, enter on line 3... 300 360 260 310 240 260 170 210 120 160". The before-November-19-1996 column is screened: retirement.special refuses ("Form 1099-R special cases") a distribution involving "a pension or annuity in which you have after-tax cost whose annuity starting date was before November 19, 1996", and retirement.annuity, which routes to the worksheet, asks for "an annuity starting date after November 18, 1996". The refused set includes the p. 30 condition 1 annuities ("Your annuity starting date was after July 1, 1986, and you used this method last year") that start before November 19, 1996; that is a documented scope reduction, not a computation error. Same as the archived rulings, rechecked against the current rendering.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040gi p. 29, Simplified Method Worksheet, line 5: "If your annuity starting date was before 1987, skip lines 6 and 7 and enter this amount on line 8. Otherwise, go to line 6". A starting date before 1987 is before November 19, 1996, so every such annuity with after-tax cost is refused by retirement.special ("a pension or annuity in which you have after-tax cost whose annuity starting date was before November 19, 1996") and retirement.annuity requires a start after November 18, 1996; on every completed return the "Otherwise" branch applies and line 8 is "the smaller of line 5 or line 7". Same as the archived rulings, rechecked.
